data.narrative:
Heven AeroTech, a Series B-stage defense and security technology company, carries a current post-money valuation of $1.0B against $100M+ in total raised capital. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods are applicable and yield convergent results. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $1.9B. Peer-median benchmarking across six same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $1.1B, with the peer cohort ranging from $300M to $3.0B. The median valuation across the peer set ($1.1B) sits modestly above the current $1.0B post-money, reflecting Heven's positioning within the distribution.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $956M (low), $1.5B (median), and $2.2B (high). The median implies modest upside from current valuation, while the wide range—reflecting the $300M-to-$3.0B dispersion in defense-sector Series B outcomes—underscores substantial uncertainty around timing, capital efficiency, and customer concentration. Key sensitivities remain contract pipeline maturity and the pace of government procurement cycles.
